title: UI风格#203 - Vintage Botanical (复古植物)
description: 创建第203种UI风格：复古植物风格 - 19世纪植物学、精细插图、古典科学。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGU.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Botanical style When color palette Then features sepia, forest green, aged cream, rust
Given Vintage Botanical style When typography Then uses botanical serif: EB Garamond, Libre Baskerville
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：EB Garamond (植物), Libre Baskerville (古典)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Botanical style When layout Then specimen plates, vintage illustrations, handwritten labels
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：标本板、老式插图、手写标签

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Botanical style When UI elements Then aged paper, botanical illustrations, fine line drawings
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：陈旧纸张、植物插图、精细线条画

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Botanical UI When functional Then includes herbarium chat, collector agents, catalog stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：植物标本聊天、收藏家代理、目录统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Botanical UI When copy Then uses collector: 'Specimen', 'Collector', 'Herbarium', 'Classify'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SPECIMEN. COLLECTOR. HERBARIUM.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'CATALOG'、'DEPLOY'→'CLASSIFY'
